items.title: Smart ring maker Oura postpones IPO due to market 'uncertainty'
items.description: Oura said the delay comes despite "strong demand" and a strengthenthing of the business since the start of the IPO process.

items.title: Trump’s municipal bond portfolio reaches as much as $1 billion as policy overlaps mount
items.description: President Donald Trump disclosed municipal bond holdings worth $300 million to $1 billion, including debt tied to issuers affected by federal policy.

items.title: Meta launches Muse for Small Business as Zuckerberg pushes beyond consumer AI market
items.description: Following the success of its Muse personal AI agent, Meta is introducing a specialized version for small businesses.

items.title: Putin orders army expansion as Zelenskyy warns Russia preparing to deploy 10,000 North Korean troops
items.description: The decree marks the fourth increase in Russia’s military staffing levels this year as the war in Ukraine continues into a fifth winter.

items.title: Mistral CEO says U.S. AI safety debate masks competitors’ 'negligence'
items.description: Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch criticized rivals’ AI safety arguments as the industry faces scrutiny after several AI agents took unauthorized actions.

items.title: Luckin Coffee weighs entry into Middle East markets, chairman tells CNBC
items.description: Luckin is weighing a push into Middle East markets while deepening its foothold in Southeast Asia, with backing from sovereign wealth funds in both regions.

items.title: China has three new criteria for humanoid robot IPOs. Few, if any, meet them
items.description: China's securities regulator is raising the bar for public listings of humanoid robot startups with three specific criteria, according to three sources.

items.title: India readies $25 billion for Deep Tech investment as U.S. and China race ahead
items.description: In a bid to cut its reliance on foreign tech, India tries to catch up with China and the U.S. by readying an investment of $25 billion in Deep Tech startups.

items.title: Australia says more hikes not off the table after raising rates to 15-year high
items.description: The hike of 25 basis points was in line with expectations by economists polled by Reuters.

items.title: U.S., Iran hold separate mediator talks as Mideast oil exports hit war-time high
items.description: Iranian and U.S. officials reportedly met separately with mediators Monday to push for a ceasefire, as Middle Eastern crude exports rebounded to war-time high.

items.title: Senate advances college sports bill aimed at regulating NIL deals
items.description: The Senate voted Monday on the bill, which would create a national framework for name, image and likeness deals in college athletics.

items.title: Samsung to inject $1 billion into Nvidia- and KKR-backed AI infrastructure firm
items.description: Samsung Electronics and its five affiliates are investing $1 billion in KKR-launched Helix as the group expands its push into global AI infrastructure.

items.title: LeBron James is already boosting ticket and merchandise demand for Philadelphia 76ers
items.description: NBA star LeBron James is having a major financial impact on the Philadelphia 76ers and Philadelphia, boosting sponsorships, ticket sales and economic activity

items.title: AMD briefly joined the $1 trillion club. Cramer says its monster run isn’t over
items.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said AMD’s run isn’t over, arguing the rise of agentic AI will drive significant demand for the company’s high-end CPUs.

items.title: AMD acquiring Fei-Fei Li's World Labs AI firm in deal worth $8.2 billion
items.description: AMD previously invested in World Labs before the acquisition, which is the chipmaker's second biggest on record.

items.title: Feds can't withhold counterterrorism funds from states to force election admin changes, judge rules
items.description: The judge said FEMA never explained how the election changes it wanted were "tied to the goal of shoring up vulnerabilities to terrorist attacks."

items.title: Khanna to introduce AI safety bill with ban on 'recursive' technology until safeguards exist
items.description: The proposal joins a chorus of other measures being put forward in Congress as the body mulls how to regulate AI.

items.title: Trump announces plan for $15 billion steel plant, would be largest in U.S. history
items.description: Trump's announcement with Mesabi Metallics comes as Americans' souring views of the economy are poised to shape the upcoming midterm election.

items.title: Michael Burry believes the AI bubble 'may burst' sooner than he first believed
items.description: The famed short seller is switching to puts with expiries in June for his major tech short bets.

items.title: OpenAI sparked Hugging Face bids with early investment offer ahead of Nvidia's $13 billion deal
items.description: Hugging Face saw a flurry of deal interest before Nvidia agreed to buy the open-source platform for roughly $13 billion, CNBC has learned.
